label: nx_option_help_010
text:
Welcome to the Options menu!
You can change the language Pokémon HOME uses, as well as the volume
of its music and sound effects here. This is also where you can check what plan
you have!

label: nx_option_help_015
text:
But if you want to see how long your Premium Plan
is valid for, you can’t do that here...
You’ll need to check the store where you
signed up!

label: nx_option_help_020
text:
Also, if you ever run into trouble and need to contact
customer support, you’ll need the Support ID shown here!
